title: One drawing layer inside a figure

name.description: Layer name. Also the stable address used by `jplot config set`.

data.description: Input tables for this layer. Omit for layers that draw from share_data only.

share_data.description: Publish this layer's prepared table under a name later layers can use as data[].source.

combine.description: How multiple data blocks are joined. Note: 'seperate' is spelled that way in the runtime (Figure/layer_runtime.py); G3/R4 renames it with an alias.

axes.description: Which axes of the style card to draw on. Run `jplot cap styles` to see the axes a card provides (this is where names like 'axc' come from).

coordinates.description: Column/expression mapping per coordinate. Which keys are required depends on `method`.

colorbar.description: Name of the colorbar axes this layer feeds. Defaults to 'axc'.

style.description: Passed through to matplotlib. Jarvis-PLOT does not enumerate these keys; it only reports ownership conflicts with frame.axc.color.

methodName.description: Rendering primitive. Authoritative list: jarvisplot/Figure/method_registry.py::METHOD_DISPATCH (kept in sync by tests/test_schema_catalog.py).

source.description: A root DataSet name, or a name published by another layer's share_data.

transform.description: Ordered pre-steps applied to this block only.

layerCoordinate.description: Either an expression mapping, or a literal value/array drawn as-is (used for reference lines that need no dataset). `if/then` rather than `oneOf`, so the mapping form keeps precise unknown-key errors instead of degrading to 'not valid under any of the given schemas'.

fillna.description: Value substituted for NaN in this coordinate.

name.description: Not read here. Output column naming belongs to a transform's coordinates block.

lim.description: Not read here. Axis range is owned by the frame.

scale.description: Not read here. Axis scale is owned by the frame.

label.description: Not read here. Axis labels are owned by the frame.
